name: Teach For Malaysia
summary: Builds a network of teachers and education leaders so that every child in Malaysia, especially in high-need schools, gets a good education.
programmes: Two-year Fellowship (Guru Muda) placing teachers in high-need schools
Community mobilisation (Program Komuniti Perkasa) with B40 families
impact: 181,000+ students in 823 schools through Program Duta Guru in 2025 (Impact Report 2025)
56 Fellows teaching 5,600 students in 30 schools in 2025 (Impact Report 2025)
Merdeka Award, Education and Community category, 2022
beneficiaries: Students in high-need, low-income (B40) and PPR communities, and their teachers

organisation.leadership: YAM Tunku Ali Redhauddin ibni Tuanku Muhriz (Chairman & Founding Trustee); Chan Soon Seng (Chief Executive Officer); Trustees: Chen Li-Kai, Dato' Tharuma Rajah, Shahnaz Al-Sadat Mohsein (Founding Trustee), Datuk Yvonne Chia, YBhg. Datuk Dr. Habibah Abdul Rahim

taxExemption.statement: Stated, no reference (donate page cites LHDN Subseksyen 44(6) and calls TFM a Ministry of Finance tax-exempt organisation; no reference or validity printed)

organisation.accounts: Impact/annual reports public for 2012-2025. Latest: Impact Report 2025 https://teachformalaysia.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/TFM-Impact-Report-2025-Eng.pdf (reports 2025 income and expenditure of RM23.7m each). Audited financial statements are not linked.
